name: @peterwangze/claude-trigger-router
description: Intelligent trigger-based router for Claude Code with automatic task type detection and model routing

scripts.test:route-ux: vitest --run src/router/route-preview.test.ts src/doctor/index.test.ts src/governance/stream-response-governance.test.ts src/index-startup.test.ts src/e2e/cli-e2e.test.ts -t "route preview|previews route decisions|router slot summary|emits streamed chunks|readable SSE error|remote forwarding|structured 502|upstream error payloads|SmartRouter rules route|SmartRouter selects"
scripts.test:stream-stability: vitest --run src/utils/rewriteStream.test.ts src/utils/SSEParser.transform.test.ts src/governance/stream-response-governance.test.ts src/index-startup.test.ts && npm run test:route-ux
scripts.test:resume-stability: vitest --run src/governance/trace.test.ts src/router/index.test.ts src/trigger/analyzer.test.ts src/trigger/selector.test.ts src/governance/context-alignment.test.ts src/index-startup.test.ts src/utils/config.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:cli:entry: vitest --run src/e2e/cli-e2e.test.ts -t "help exits cleanly|init --force generates|doctor can repair|start/status/stop work|code reuses|ui prints|setup can create a fresh config|setup can create a remote-service client config|setup can create a server deployment profile"

author: peterwangze
